units.name: Escuela de Ingeniería y Ciencias
units.evidence: Current official school graduate catalogue explicitly hosts DCI; direct programme page formal Ingeniería Industrial research line establishes substantive production planning, quality, human factors, OR and supply chain research.

decisions.reason: Actual DCI school and Industrial Engineering research line verified, but exact advertised Institute for Advanced Materials for Sustainable Manufacturing / Supply Chain and Logistics Systems administrative host remains unexamined; no unsupported equivalence.

sources.note: Entire rendered official DCI programme read through Chrome accessibility tree after body-extraction timeout. Doctorado en Ciencias de Ingeniería, 13 trimesters, original research generating new knowledge under thesis adviser/committee; degree-recognition statement. Formal research line Ingeniería Industrial explicitly at Monterrey, Ciudad de México and Guadalajara, substantive production quality/planning, human factors, OR/simulation/optimization, supply chain robustness and resilience. Four broad lines include mechatronics/manufacturing, energy/water, IE, telecom. Campus list for whole degree is wider than IE line; not all-campus IE inference. Faculty biographies not researched as careers.

Entire School of Engineering and Sciences graduate catalogue read. Actual Escuela de Ingeniería y Ciencias host explicitly lists DCI among four doctorates (Biotechnology, Computational Sciences, Engineering Sciences, Nanotechnology) and master programmes. Manufacturing/quality systems and engineering-management master programmes not promoted to independent doctorates. Business doctoral inventory not examined.

limitations: Imported Institute for Advanced Materials for Sustainable Manufacturing / Supply Chain and Logistics Systems unit remains unresolved; current DCI school is not assumed the historical advertised institute.
Exact Spanish academic research-doctorate title preserved, not converted to PhD or a separate Industrial Engineering degree.
Business doctoral inventory and detailed fields of other engineering doctorates remain incomplete.
Industrial Engineering line explicitly offered at Monterrey, Ciudad de México and Guadalajara; wider DCI campus list not assumed same line at every campus.
